message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" They want earliest reference from historical record. We can answer: earliest references are in the New Testament (Gospels), but also in non-Christian sources: Josephus (Antiquities 18.3), Tacitus (Annals 15.44), Pliny the Younger (letters 10.96), Suetonius (Lives of the Caesars 1.2). The earliest is probably Josephus, written around 93-94 AD, referencing Jesus as "the Christ". Also Tacitus wrote about Christ in 116 AD. So earliest is Josephus.
